server.description: Fetch a URL and return its content as Markdown.

operator_note: Needs outbound HTTPS to the URLs it is asked to fetch. The manifest declares no egress destinations because they are not known in advance; the Standalone profile does not restrict egress, and under the Enforced profile the Egress Broker (E-18) must grant destinations by policy. Build and run with the same Python minor version (the artifact contains compiled wheels).
